blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte attends the 52nd Philippine Business Conference and Expo of the Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry in October. Photo by Inday Sara Duterte/Facebook MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte has described corruption as a “progressive disease” integrated into the government that hinders every Filipino to achieve a good future for them and their families. Duterte on Wednesday shared that this was part of her message as she attended the 52nd Philippine Business Conference and Expo of the Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry last month.
